newsitem.title: GERMANY: SAA drops some end Dec, early Jan ex-FRA fr.
newsitem.headline: SAA drops some end Dec, early Jan ex-FRA fr.

text.p: South African Airways said it will cancel several freighter services over the Christmas and New Year period due to low market demand.
SAA Germany cargo sales manager Hugo Duchemin said the airline faced "a low budget period" until January 15 due to production breaks in Europe.
The joint freighter flights with Lufthansa Cargo AG on December 26 and 31 and on January 2 and 7 would thus be cancelled, he said.
From mid-January business should pick up again thanks to increasing northbound transport of perishables as well as the general European return to work.
South African Airways had seen good business up to the Christmas period thanks to strong demand, Duchemin added.
SAA and Lufthansa fly three freighter flights a week between Frankfurt and Johannesburg using a Boeing 747 aircraft.
